title: Error Handling
learning_outcomes: Explain and apply core ideas from Error Handling.
Trace one small example and identify a meaningful edge case.
Use official documentation to check details that depend on the toolchain or ecosystem.

overview_visual.caption: Representative milestones for module 10; all lessons remain listed in sequence.

notes: Represent failures explicitly and propagate recoverable errors without hiding them. Expected failures should normally be represented by Result. Use ? only in a function whose return type can represent the propagated error.
